info.title: Task Manager — Frontend API / taskover.ir
info.description: Current main route inventory and FormRequest validation, with complete dashboard schemas and frontend integration rules. Other resource response examples originate from existing project documentation and are illustrative rather than a strict exhaustive resource schema. Contextual exists/unique/not_in rules still depend on the current authenticated user and bound resource; exported validation is not a replacement for server validation. Report compatibility repair is deployed on https://taskover.ir; dashboard API is unchanged.

progress_percentage.description: Mean effective progress over explicitly project-eligible assignment statuses; completed contributes 100, others use COALESCE(progress_percentage,0). Round half up to 2 decimals.

x-deployment.route_fingerprint_algorithm: sha256 of sorted METHOD /uri lines joined by newline
x-deployment.source: Deployed Laravel main route table and reviewed Report/Task comment FormRequests/resources; verified against server.

x-frontend-integration.json_requests: Use Content-Type application/json. For uploads use FormData and let the browser set the multipart boundary.

dashboard.availability: Check available before reading count/items. Missing module permission is unavailable on dashboard; independent project endpoint returns 403.
dashboard.rounding: Half up to two decimals; zero denominator => zero. Do not recompute or merge statuses in the UI.
dashboard.refresh: Refresh dashboard/project queries after successful task/request/report/meeting changes.

completion.ui_hint_fa: برای پیشرفت کمتر از ۱۰۰، دکمه درخواست پایان را غیرفعال کنید؛ پیام errors.progress_percentage برای خطای ۴۲۲ نمایش داده شود.
completion.schedule_time: For completed tasks use the accepted completion_requested_at. completed_at is an explicitly counted historical fallback. Pending approval remains open. Current due_date ends in Asia/Tehran; critical window is 48 elapsed hours.
completion.missing_time_reason: missing_completed_at is the compatibility key for both completion timestamps missing.
completion.history: New attempt history context preserves timestamps/deadline; old rows may have null context.

projects.definition: Tags with visible assignment tasks; fixed tag_id order; completed effective progress=100, others current progress; excludes draft/rejected/closed/not_completed from mean.

action_type.null: Unclassified; existing/older clients may omit it.

reports.resource: All ReportResource outputs include allowed_actions and action_type. All report comment outputs include allowed_actions (edit/delete/reply/react), mentions and actor-specific reactions.
reports.allowed_actions: Display supported operations only when the matching flag is strictly true. The server still authorizes requests independently; handle 403,404,409,422 and refresh after changes.
reports.activation: Deactivation preserves exact previous status and timestamps. Inactive reports allow reads and authorized report deletion, but no edits/send/view marking/comment mutations/reactions/mention lookup. Activation needs a stored known previous state; legacy unknown state returns409. Linked report edit/delete still requires scheduled meeting; send/activation/comments retain existing meeting-state rules.
